title: ci: schedule the ui jobs, Build Docs and Test Core for the root inputs they read (package.json, five ui test inputs)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoQw2SaxD3ZKQgJ2Det3rETu)_

Fixes #27717
Fixes #27961

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Tier H: the diff touches `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `.github/workflows/lint.yml`. The maintainer approves in this PR.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 根 `package.json` 进入 `ci.yml` 的 `ui:` 和 `docs:` 过滤列表；五个 ui 测试输入进入 `core:`；`check-ci-filter-parity` 增加第四个对账主题（通用 `test` 任务的根输入）；`lint.yml` 一个步骤的名称、注释和结尾文字不再写死成员个数。
- **为什么改：** 只升级 pnpm 版本（`packageManager` 字段）的 PR 现在一个 UI 任务、Build Docs 都不跑；改 `ui/vitest.config.mts` 这类文件的 PR 不跑 Test Core。两种情况都要等到合并队列才第一次运行。
- **风险与回滚：** 只多调度、不少调度。30 天回放：UI 任务多 11/3683 次，Build Docs 多 18/3683 次，Test Core 多 2/3683 次。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** ① `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的 `ui:` / `docs:` / `core:` 三处新增行；② `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` 的 `judgeTestInputs` 和 `judgeBuildInputs` 里 `reasons` 那一行；③ `.github/workflows/lint.yml` 的 shared-module self-tests 步骤。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs --self-test && node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`，预期 138 条断言通过，三个 OK 行，其中一行是 "all 8 root input(s) of `test` / `test:repo`"。
- **需要你做的：** 在本 PR 上批准（Tier H）。

## What changes

**#27717: the root manifest schedules every job that reads its `packageManager` field.** `.github/actions/setup-pnpm/action.yml` reads `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package.json`'s `packageManager` to pick the pnpm it materialises. Measured which `ci.yml` jobs run it, at `origin/main` `2e955dde`:

| filter list | jobs that run setup-pnpm | `package.json` row before |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `core` | every core job, through `setup-workspace` | yes |
| `ui` | `ui-deps`, `type-check-ui`, `test-ui`, `lint-ui`, `build-e2e-ui`, `live-e2e-ui` (directly) | no |
| `docs` | `build-docs`, through `setup-workspace` | no |

`ui` is the narrowest list that starts all six ui jobs (`ui_consumers` starts four of them and is held to the seven packages objectui installs), so the row goes there. **Declared increment, approved by the dispatching seat:** the same row joins `docs:`, because Build Docs has the same hole, in the same file, the same gate family and the shape #27673 used for `.nvmrc` and the setup actions. No other list changes.

The parity gate header named setup-pnpm as "today's one" local composite action the guard recognizer does not follow, and said every job in every workflow runs it. Build Core's step `uses:` setup-workspace (which calls setup-pnpm), and 18 of 30 workflows use either action. The bound now names setup-workspace, states that neither action's `run:` steps name a repository script (what the self-test's bound-2 case already pins against the real job), and says the files they read are `core:` rows of their own.

**#27961: Test Core starts on a diff confined to a generic test input.** turbo.json's generic `test` task has eight `$TURBO_ROOT$` inputs. Three were already covered (`vitest.preset.mts` by hand, `ui/scripts/vite-*.ts` and `ui/scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` by the #27283 build rows). The five below matched no list Test Core's `if:` reads, and now sit in `core:` beside the six ui build rows:

- `ui/vitest.config.mts`
- `ui/vitest.setup.*`
- `ui/scripts/test-shard-*`
- `ui/apps/console/vitest.config.ts`
- `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`

The `ci.yml` authorisation precedent is ruling 6513291766 on #27283 (letter A, maintainer 「其他同意」), which this card inherits per triage 6516081082 ("Item 1 is the same shape as ruling `6513291766` (the six `build` inputs), one task over. It adds no gate"):

> **What the ruling binds (letter A):** the six ui-root build inputs that PR #27571 adds to the root `turbo.json` [...] also enter `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `core:` path filter, in the same PR, so a diff confined to one of them schedules Build Core and Test Core on the PR instead of first in the merge queue, and `check-ci-filter-parity` is green by parity, not by blindness.

**The fourth parity subject, and why it is required rather than optional.** With the five rows added and the gate unchanged, `check:ci-filter-parity` went RED: the third subject's leftover rule reported `ui/vitest.config.mts` as a leftover `core:` row. That rule judges a literal row in any directory holding a literal build input, `ui/` holds `ui/tsconfig.json`, and no reason it knew covered the new row. (`ui/vitest.setup.*` and `ui/scripts/test-shard-*` carry wildcards and are not judged; `ui/apps/console/` holds no build input.) So the gate now:

- derives the root inputs of turbo.json's generic `test` and `test:repo` tasks (the pair Test Core's `turbo run test test:repo` names, pinned against the real job) and judges them with the existing pure-string rule against `core` + `crosspkg`, read back out of the `test` job's `if:` exactly as the first subject reads them. Remedy: a `core:` row, never `crosspkg:`, which the first subject holds to the cross-package declarations;
- counts those inputs as reasons for the third subject's leftover rule, so a `core:` row kept for a test input is no leftover.

This strengthens an existing gate; no new gate, no new CI step. Per-package `#test` inputs stay the first subject's population (measured: with this diff, every `$TURBO_ROOT$` input of every `test` / `test:repo` task in turbo.json is covered by `core` + `crosspkg`, 0 uncovered).

**#27961 item 2: `lint.yml`'s shared-module self-test step.** It runs five self-tests since #27571 added `ui/scripts/invoked-as.mjs --self-test`, but its name listed four modules, its comment said "The four modules" and its last line printed "all four ran and passed". The name now lists the members (`parse · entry predicate, root and ui · comment mask · prerequisite frame`), the comment explains why the ui twin is there and pins no count, and the last line reads "every one ran and passed". The comment's "~0.6 s combined" for the in-process self-tests is re-measured at ~0.9 s for the four of them (four node starts, this container). Nothing reads the step name or the message (`git grep` outside `lint.yml`: no hits); the step `id` is unchanged.

## Tests

`scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs --self-test` gains battery (11), 18 cases, and the roster floor goes 9 → 10 batteries: a `test` and a `test:repo` root input each reported by path and task; an input covered only by `crosspkg` covered; package-task and negated inputs left out; five refusals (turbo.json unreadable, not JSON, no `tasks`, no generic `test` task, the `test` job's `if:` dropping `crosspkg`); the leftover rule keeping and then losing a `core:` row as its test input appears and disappears; the real tree clean; the real `ci.yml` with the five rows dropped reporting exactly those five, through `main()` too; and the task pair pinned to the real `test` job. Total 120 → 138 assertions, all passing.

## Acceptance notes

- What Test Core runs on such a diff is the existing shard plan's answer (`turbo ls --affected` unioned with declarations); this PR only makes the job start. Not measured here.
- Scheduling price, replayed through picomatch 4.0.7 over the 3683 first-parent commits of `main` in the 30 days to `2e955dde`, current filters against current filters plus these rows: `ui` 690 → 701, `docs` 1037 → 1055, `core` 2758 → 2760, Test Core (`core` or `crosspkg`) 3255 → 3257.

## Verification

All readings on head `115b9df6f` (`objectstack-ai/objectstack`), merge base `2e955dde6`.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 66 commands over 3 paths. Each was run with stdin from `/dev/null` and its exit code recorded before any pipe: **66 exit 0**. `check:type-check-debt` first hit my 280 s per-command cap (exit 124) and was re-run uncapped: exit 0. The four dist-reading Build Core guards (`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`) ran after the type-check-debt closure build and each swept real `dist/` (e.g. "76 built package(s) swept - 235/235 declared declaration file(s) present").
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: "66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 66 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- In that set: `check:ci-filter-parity` (self-test 138 assertions, three OK lines), `check:pm-expected-skips`, `check:required-contexts`, `check:workflow-status-functions`, `check:self-test-wired`, `check:step-collectors`, `check:node-version`, `check:pnpm-acquisition`, `check:pm-dispatch-gates`: all exit 0.
- Red before green, on a scratch copy of this head with only the five #27961 rows removed from `ci.yml`: `check-ci-filter-parity` exit 1, "5 root input(s) of `test` / `test:repo` in turbo.json are covered by NEITHER `core` nor `crosspkg`", naming exactly the five. With the five rows and the gate as it was on `main`: exit 1, "`ui/vitest.config.mts`" reported as a leftover `core:` row (the reason the fourth subject is required).
- `eslint --no-inline-config scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`: exit 0.
- No package source changed, so no package build or test is owed; no changeset (`skip-changeset`: `.github/workflows/**` and a root `scripts/` gate publish nothing).
